title: ChatRequest
description: A natural-language design request from the browser. project_id is REQUIRED: every request is explicitly project-scoped (see .kiro/steering/security.md project isolation). String identifiers must be non-blank: `minLength` alone would admit whitespace-only values, so a `\S` pattern is required alongside it.

selected_object_id.description: Optional browser-selected object the user is referring to.
